title: Support desk
subtitle: 6 agents in 3 queues. ~400 tickets a week. Daily check-ins on exceptions only.
updated: Last updated on Wednesday 23 September at 6pm. The board only changes when something new comes in, such as a check-in, a report, a decision or a number from another system.
question: Resolve customer issues within a day, without reopening them?
headline: 412 tickets this week. 91% were solved within a day
under: The numbers come from the helpdesk, so they are proven. The open questions are why 7 tickets were passed to engineering and 17 were opened again.
reported: Check-ins covered 38 exceptions; the other 374 tickets needed no one's account.
